hunches.title: Colston Loveland against a defense tight ends have hurt
ev: 8 lead tight ends have had 4+ targets against DET: 5 cleared 45 yards, average 57.
Colston Loveland has averaged 6.0 targets over his last 3 games (65, 54, 29 yards).

vs.t: Tight-end yardage swings on one or two catches; four to nine games is a thin record for a defense.

hunches.title: Caleb Williams against a defense that gives up passing TDs
ev: DET has allowed 2.1 passing TDs a game, 3rd most: 8 of 10 starting quarterbacks threw 2 or more.
The betting lines put CHI at about 29 points.
Caleb Williams's last 3 games: 1, 2, 2 passing TDs.
Against pass defenses like this one in 2024-25 (5 games with a real workload) he averaged 2.2 passing TDs and cleared 2 in 3.

vs.t: Missing pieces on his side: Kmet out (4% of targets).
